The error comes from the word "input" in the program's comments, which trips the forbidden-construct check. The topology and current budget look sound, so the fix is to remove that word and keep everything else the same. The budget is 1.8 V × (45 µA + 10 µA) ≈ 99 µW, below the 140 µW limit. Getting 240 MHz GBW into 500 fF needs gm ≥ 754 µS, and two devices at about 45 µA each give roughly 1.1 mS. Swapping the comments makes the program valid, but I haven't run it yet, so these performance numbers are still only estimates.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":   (45e-6, 25e-6, 60e-6),   # inverter branch current at vin=0.75
    "Ln":  (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),        # NMOS gain-device length
    "Lp":  (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),        # PMOS gain-device length
    "A_t": (9.6, 8.5, 11.0),        # target |gain| (sets R)
    "Lb":  (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),         # ibias termination diode length
}

def _solve_w(lut, dev, L, vgs, vds, I):
    W = 5.0
    for _ in range(6):
        o = lut.op(dev, W, L, vgs, vds)
        W = min(max(W * I / max(o["Id"], 1e-12), 0.42), 4000.0)
    return W, lut.op(dev, W, L, vgs, vds)

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    I, Ln, Lp, A_t = p["I"], p["Ln"], p["Lp"], p["A_t"]
    vout0 = vin  # feedback R carries ~0 DC current when In = Ip

    # Size both gain devices so each carries I with its gate at vin.
    Wn, on = _solve_w(lut, "n", Ln, vin, vout0, I)
    Wp, op_ = _solve_w(lut, "p", Lp, vdd - vin, vdd - vout0, I)
    gm = on["gm"] + op_["gm"]
    G = on["gds"] + op_["gds"]

    # Parasitic output capacitance estimate (cdd + cgd).
    dn = lut.size("n", max(on["gm_id"], 3), Ln, I, vds=vout0)
    dp = lut.size("p", max(op_["gm_id"], 3), Lp, I, vds=vdd - vout0)
    cpar = dn.cdd + dp.cdd + dn.cgd + dp.cgd
    ctot = cl + cpar

    # A = (gm - 1/R) / (1/R + G)  ->  R = (A + 1) / (gm - A*G)
    den = max(gm - A_t * G, 0.2 * gm)
    R = (A_t + 1.0) / den
    Rout = 1.0 / (1.0 / R + G)
    A = (gm - 1.0 / R) * Rout
    f3db = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rout * ctot)
    gbw = A * f3db

    # Terminate the ibias port with a diode-connected NMOS (DC path for IREF).
    mb = lut.size("n", 10, p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.7)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MN", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)
    n.M("MP", "vout", "vin", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.R("RL", "vout", "vin", R)
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)

    power = vdd * (I + iref)
    vdsat = max(on.get("vdsat", 0.1), op_.get("vdsat", 0.1))
    swing = vdd - 2 * max(vdsat, 0.1) - 0.05
    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vout0,
        "swing": swing,
    }
```
